power.assumptions: Observed receipt-day schedules repeated with zero days intact. Earliest complete receipt through cutoff inclusive; partial UTC days count in full. Synthetic independent outcomes at fair price plus case shift on decisive stake. Observed prices, competitions, missing-result and push/half-stake patterns. v3.1 pair-difference kernel and pair, cluster, coverage, leave-one-out, lower-bound and two-layer alpha gates. Fitted correction and absolute announced-return gate. Sampled effects describe planning only.

counterfactual_fresh_same_contract_obser.note: Upper bound for planning only: cases whose blocking stage was clock-compatible availability, staleness or price, and which have at least one clock-compatible same-contract fixture with a point price within the caliper at its nearest known quote, not reserved, with FT. Correspondence (antecedent absent at the instant) is not checked.

counterfactual_interval_cases.note: Cases blocked only because their own quote is an interval; counts by interval width. v3.1 keeps requiring a point price; using bounds needs a new pre-registered protocol.
